rationale: roles validates the ASCII ID grammar and recognizes only adjacent supported role syntax outside code, links, images and HTML blocks, respecting escaped prefixes and double-backtick demonstrations. chapter_roles combines structured IDs and legacy definitions; process_with_roots indexes all nested chapters before rendering and rejects duplicates. render_role rejects unknown anchors, produces local shield HTML, inherits surrounding labels, and uses relative_html for normalized relative chapter paths. Tests cover forward and parent-directory references, duplicate IDs across role kinds, invalid IDs, literal examples and labels without proof implications. The inspected CSS has no remote badge URL.
limitations: This is the documented custom role subset, not a full MyST parser; a Definition shield alone does not imply a cited formalization.
